name: Capability comparison table
purpose: Gives evaluators a scannable, link-rich checklist of what the platform covers against their requirements.
description: Raw-HTML-style table embed with its own px-based CSS (re-scoped nct-* classes) and a centred serif H2 (with an italic phrase) plus grey intro above it. One component with a `variant` prop: platform (/lms) is a 2-column capability / 'what you can do' table of 11 rows, nudged 40px right on desktop; enterprise (/lms/enterprise) is a 2-column requirement / provision table of 7 rows whose right cells are green-edged chat-bubble evidence cards; vendor (/nova, directly after the split-tabs block) is a 4-column evaluation checklist (area, what to ask, what good looks like, Nimbus evidence bubble) of 7 rows. Column headers and the visually hidden caption are fixed per variant. At <=767 every variant collapses to stacked rows (vendor cells gain uppercase data-labels).

The /nova table sits visually inside the preceding SplitTabs block (no bottom padding between them), but it is a separate component in the page, so no mustImmediatelyFollow is declared.
